timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Transthoracic echo: LVEF 60%, grade I diastolic dysfunction

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 69-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.56, bnp 212, creatinine 0.84, hemoglobin 13, platelets 223, sodium 141, wbc 6; vitals dbp 64-70, heart_rate 74-79, map 87-92, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-17, sbp 130-135, spo2 97-98, temp 36.6-36.7
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Furosemide 20 mg PO daily (home med); Transthoracic echo: LVEF 60%, grade I diastolic dysfunction
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.85, hemoglobin 13, platelets 224, sodium 140, wbc 5.8; vitals dbp 66-69, heart_rate 74-77, map 88-91, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-17, sbp 132-137, spo2 96-98, temp 36.6-36.9
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Furosemide 20 mg PO daily (home med)
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 69-year-old male, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed.
